proposals.title: Add view that shows done state
proposals.change: Add a browser-side TaskListView class, placed in the Browser page component DSN-003. It renders each task with a checkbox that is ticked when done is true and with struck-through text, and it has a method that calls PATCH when the user ticks or unticks. Add a final SEQ-003 message that re-renders the task from the returned Task, so the done and not-done states look different.
